🌬️ The Complete Woosa Guide

A graceful yet deadly caster who commands wind, rain, and thunder. Sweep through mobs with elegant AOE, or weave through enemies in PvP with slippery movement and precise CC.

Maintained by Carved Updated 6/6/2026 Succession + Awakening Status: Updated For PvP & PvE

🌸 Introduction

Woosa is a master of the Do Arts — a graceful yet deadly caster who commands wind, rain, and thunder. Whether she's sweeping through mobs with elegant AOE or weaving through enemies in PvP with slippery movement and precise CC, Woosa rewards players who enjoy fluidity, control, and tactical spellcasting.

This guide gives you a complete, polished overview of both Succession and Awakening, including combos, mechanics, and practical insights.

Woosa Update Log: updated and maintained by JaykunVT

🌧️ Class Identity & Playstyle

Woosa excels at

  • Large, fast AOE damage
  • High protection uptime
  • Flexible cancels and movement
  • Strong ranged pressure
  • Reliable CC tools
  • Fluid transitions between stances
Succession focuses on wind, storms, and cloud mechanics, while Awakening revolves around Sari Flowers, delayed explosions, and calligraphy magic. Both kits are viable — Succession is more fluid and mobile, Awakening is more deliberate and explosive.

🌪️ Succession Woosa

3.1 Core Mechanics

Succession revolves around:

  • Storm Clouds (White Waters passive)
  • Wind-based AOE
  • Forward Guard uptime
  • Flexible cancels
  • Reliable CC
Storm clouds can be summoned, activated, and detonated for bonus damage and debuffs.

🌙 Awakening Woosa

4.1 Lore & Theme

Awakening Woosa forms a pact with the spirit Sah, gaining the Soul Tome and Calligraphy Brush. Her kit revolves around Sari Flowers, delayed explosions, and elegant magical patterns.

4.2 Core Mechanics

  • Sari Flowers (delayed explosions)
  • Linear AOEs
  • Protected burst windows
  • Repositioning through Soul Cleanse
  • Weapon swapping for sustain and CC

🌟 Final Thoughts

Woosa is one of the most elegant, fluid, and rewarding classes. Whether you prefer the storm-weaving flow of Succession or the explosive artistry of Awakening, she offers depth, mobility, and style that few classes can match.

  • Easy, chill grinder: Awoosa
  • Easy, lil bit sweatier grinder: Succ Woosa
